title: Zakat in the Age of Digital Transformation: Technology Platform for Effective Collection and Distribution Management
core_idea: Evaluate how adoption of digital technologies affects efficiency, transparency, and accountability in zakat collection and distribution, with attention to demographic influences and barriers to access and digital literacy, to inform strategies for inclusive technology integration in zakat institutions.
tldr: Study investigates the role of digital technology in improving zakat management (collection and distribution), examining demographic factors and access/digital literacy barriers to guide inclusive technology adoption strategies.
